verdict.rationale: Greptile's core function is generating AI insights from the user's own codebase: severity-sorted review findings with suggested code fixes, a 0-5 merge-confidence score, auto-generated sequence diagrams and flowcharts, synthesized repository knowledge-base docs, and suggestions that adapt to team feedback. An independent user reports it 'catches real issues', though earlier hands-on reports describe incomplete or incorrect answers and repo-processing failures. Missing for 10: consistent independent evidence of insight accuracy across codebases (several community tests found wrong or failed answers), and depth on in-product (dashboard) insight surfaces beyond PR comments.
